description: 表达式数据源:多设备计算值(平均电量)直接内联绑定,不该先建 transform。新维度:expression data_source(覆盖 source:expression + expr 引用真实指标)

turns.user: Create a dashboard called Avg Board with one card showing the average battery level of sensor-001 and sensor-002.

per_turn: Turn 1: `neomind device get` (discover values.battery) → `neomind dashboard create --components` (or add-components) with data_source {"type":"telemetry","source":"expression","mode":"latest","expr":"avg(device:sensor-001:values.battery, device:sensor-002:values.battery)"} — NO pre-created transform
expectations.overall: 组件为 expression 数据源且 expr 含 avg 与两个设备引用
